lines.text: Many learners say: I can't support the noise.
Better: I can't stand the noise.
Stand! I can't stand the noise.

native.tip: En español “no soporto el ruido”, pero “support” en inglés es apoyar: usa “can't stand.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I can't support the noise.” “Soportar” aquí es “stand”, no “support”: “I can't stand the noise.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “stand”. “Support” es apoyar. Para algo que no aguantas, “can't stand”. Escribe una frase tuya con “stand” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: “No soporto” sounds like “support”, but “support” means to help. Use “can't stand.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I can't support the noise.” “Soportar” here is “stand”, not “support”: “I can't stand the noise.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
